title: Vui lòng gửi vị trí của tôi cho người này
englishTitle: Please send my location to this person
pronunciation: Vui long gui vi tri cua toi cho nguoi nay
summary: For asking someone to send your location to a trusted contact when you need help being found.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Show the contact, chat, map, or phone screen so the helper knows exactly who should receive it.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Keep your phone unlocked only if it feels safe. Point to the contact instead of handing over more than needed.

phrases.vietnamese: Vui lòng gửi vị trí của tôi cho người này
phrases.english: Please send my location to this person
phrases.pronunciation: Vui long gui vi tri cua toi cho nguoi nay

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Vui lòng gửi means please send; vị trí của tôi means my location; cho người này means to this person.

breakdown.vietnamese: Vui lòng gửi vị trí của tôi cho người này
breakdown.english: Please send my location to this person

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Police, ambulance, and passport cards help when location sharing is part of a larger emergency.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotels, police desks, clinics, ride pickups, stations, or late-night help moments when someone needs your location.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If you cannot share your phone, ask them to write the address or send the location from their own device.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Unsafe, emergency, help, hospital, and passport cards cover more urgent safety paths.
